texts.error.adam_firmware: Gearcoleco could not start the ADAM with the firmware given. It needs the ColecoVision BIOS (8 KB), the EOS ROM (8 KB) and the SmartWriter ROM (32 KB).
texts.error.eos_half: The firmware '%1' is 16384 bytes, but its first 8192 bytes are not the EOS ROM.
texts.error.eos_size: The firmware '%1' is %2 bytes; the EOS ROM is 8192 bytes, or 16384 bytes with the EOS ROM in its first half.
texts.error.firmware_size: The firmware '%1' is %2 bytes; it must be %3 bytes.
texts.error.media_rejected: Gearcoleco could not use '%1' as ADAM media. A disk image (.dsk) is 160 KB or 320 KB, and a data pack image (.ddp) is 256 KB.
texts.error.no_cartridge: No cartridge file is in the project.
texts.error.rejected: Gearcoleco could not load '%1' as a cartridge.
texts.error.savedata_size: The save data '%1' is %2 bytes, but this cartridge keeps %3 bytes.
texts.error.savedata_unused: The project has save data ('%1'), but this cartridge keeps none.
texts.firmware.eos.about: The ADAM's operating system ROM (8 KB), often named eos.rom.
texts.firmware.os7.about: The ColecoVision's boot ROM (8 KB), often named colecovision.rom or coleco.rom. The ADAM needs it too.
texts.firmware.writer.about: The ADAM's SmartWriter word processor ROM (32 KB), often named writer.rom or wp.rom. The ADAM runs it when it starts as a computer, and it boots the disks and data packs.
texts.setting.machine.about: The ColecoVision console, or the Coleco ADAM computer. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.mapper.about: The kind of circuit board in the cartridge, which decides how a large game switches between its banks. Automatic tells it from the game. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.nospritelimit.about: Draw every sprite on a line, not only the first four as the video chip does. The game still sees the real chip. It changes the picture only.
texts.setting.overscan.about: How much of the border around the picture is shown. It changes the picture only.
texts.setting.region.about: NTSC runs at 60 frames a second, PAL at 50. Automatic takes it from the game's entry in Gearcoleco's list of games, and is NTSC for a game not in the list. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.videochip.about: The console's TMS9918A, or the F18A, a modern replacement chip that some new games need. Automatic picks the F18A for the games Gearcoleco knows need it. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.adamcart.help: A cartridge for the ADAM to start (optional). With a cartridge and nothing in the drives, the ADAM starts the cartridge as a game. With media in a drive, the ADAM starts as a computer and the cartridge stays in its slot.
texts.slot.cart.help: The ColecoVision cartridge ROM (.col, .cv, .rom, .bin, or a .zip holding one).
texts.slot.datapack.help: A digital data pack image (.ddp, 256 KB) for this drive. What the computer writes to it stays in the machine and comes out with Export Save Data.
texts.slot.disk.help: A floppy disk image (.dsk, 160 KB or 320 KB) for this drive. What the computer writes to it stays in the machine and comes out with Export Save Data.
texts.slot.savedata.help: The memory a cartridge with a battery or an EEPROM keeps (battery.sav, as Export Save Data writes it). The game starts with it.
